content.short: Camels is a community-driven meme and gaming project on TON featuring task-based rewards and NFTs.
content.description: Camels (Camels House) is a vibrant community-led project on the TON blockchain that blends meme culture with interactive gaming and task-to-earn mechanics. Users participate in a variety of daily challenges and social quests to earn $CAMELS tokens. The project also features a unique NFT system where digital camels generate passive earnings for their holders. By fostering a playful and highly engaged community within Telegram, Camels provides a fun and accessible entry point for users to explore the benefits of digital asset ownership and social rewards on TON.
content.meta: Join the Camels community on TON and earn rewards. Meme-driven gaming and NFTs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
